test_signal.name: Test Signal
test_signal.description: Codebase has meaningful tests that verify real behavior, not just coverage theater. Look for test files, meaningful assertions, and tests that reflect actual usage patterns.

coherent_structure.name: Coherent Structure
coherent_structure.description: File organization, naming conventions, and module boundaries are consistent and logical. Names reveal intent. Related things live together.

complexity_proportionality.name: Complexity Proportional to Problem
complexity_proportionality.description: No unnecessary abstractions, no god objects, no deeply nested logic, no premature generalization. Three similar lines is better than a wrong abstraction.

security_hygiene.name: Security Hygiene
security_hygiene.description: No obvious OWASP issues: no SQL injection, no hardcoded secrets or API keys, input validated at system boundaries, no command injection or unsafe eval.

appropriate_error_handling.name: Appropriate Error Handling
appropriate_error_handling.description: Errors handled at system boundaries only. No catch-all silencing, no validation of impossible scenarios, no defensive checks on internal code that cannot fail.

dependency_justification.name: Dependency Justification
dependency_justification.description: Each dependency earns its place. No redundant, abandoned, or high-risk packages. Dependencies are used, not just installed.

ai_code_smell.name: AI Code Smell
ai_code_smell.description: No signs of blindly accepted AI output: inconsistent style within files, obvious-comment bloat explaining what instead of why, duplicated utility functions, unused imports, random TODOs without context.

mental_model_coherence.name: Mental Model Coherence
mental_model_coherence.description: Code structure suggests the author understood the problem domain and made intentional decisions. Logic flows naturally. No contradictory patterns side by side.

idiomatic_style.name: Idiomatic Style
idiomatic_style.description: Follows language conventions and ecosystem norms. Uses standard patterns rather than reinventing built-ins. Code reads like it belongs in the language.
